translations.translatedText: # Radio Clear News Wednesday 20.9.2023
Budget proposal. Kemi pulp mill. Crown Princess Victoria. Train delays. The weather.
## Budget proposal

![Finance Minister Riikka Purra (PS) answered media questions.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4999,h_2811,x_0,y_256/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-117384065095a7fd7c11/1695111878)
Open image viewer
Riikka Purra is Finland's Minister of Finance, that is, the finance minister. Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle
The government's budget proposal is ready. The budget proposal tells what the state will use money for next year.

The government presented the budget proposal on Tuesday evening. Finance minister Riikka Purra said that Finland's revenues are smaller than its expenditure. That is why Finland must take over 11 billion euros of new debt.
The budget affects Finns' lives in many ways. For example, the government wants to encourage people to work.
Because of state savings, social security will weaken. However, the wage tax will decrease, that is, the employee gets a bigger share of the wage for themselves.
Parliament will deal with and approve the budget during the autumn.
## Kemi pulp mill

![New factory photographed from the air. The factory's chimney and buildings can be seen in the picture.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1079,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1172259650314c1c10a0/1694700799)
Open image viewer
Kemi pulp mill. Photo: Metsä Group
Kemi's new pulp mill has been taken into use. The factory makes pulp from wood, which is used to make paper and cardboard.
The Kemi pulp mill is very big. It makes 1.5 million tonnes of pulp a year.
The Kemi pulp mill cost 2 billion euros. It uses 350 lorry loads of wood every day.
The Kemi pulp mill also produces electricity. Its share of Finland's entire electricity production is 2.5 percent.
## Crown Princess Victoria

![Crown Princess Victoria on a visit at Hanasaari on Wednesday.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5120,h_2880,x_0,y_70/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1174741650ae63dba7f0/1695213166)
Open image viewer
Crown Princess Victoria at the Hanasaari cultural centre on Wednesday. Photo: Jussi Nukari / Lehtikuva
Sweden's Crown Princess Victoria is visiting Finland.
On Wednesday Victoria visited Espoo. The target was the Swedish-Finnish Hanasaari cultural centre.
On Thursday the crown princess visits Helsinki and Vantaa. In addition, the crown princess will inaugurate a square in Loviisa that will be named Victoria Square.
Crown Princess Victoria is the eldest child of Sweden's King Carl Gustaf. Victoria will become ruler of Sweden after Carl Gustaf.
The 46-year-old Swedish crown princess is very popular also in Finland.
## Train delays

![Three men stand on a railway track examining track damage. On the back of their work jackets it says Destia.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_116/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1174389650a981066adf/1695193241)
Open image viewer
Trains were delayed when an accident with 2 freight trains blocked the tracks. Photo: Jani Aarnio / Yle
Many trains were delayed on Wednesday. The reason was an accident that happened in Tampere.
In the accident, 2 freight trains derailed when they hit each other. Nobody was injured in the accident.
The cause of the accident is not yet known.
## The weather
![Thursday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1174855650b1308bc0bd/1695224618)
Open image viewer
The first snow has fallen in Lapland. Snow fell during the night between Tuesday and Wednesday. In places more than 20 centimetres of snow fell.
On Wednesday it was also windy. The storm cut the power to thousands of homes.
On Thursday the weather is warm and fairly sunny in the south. In the north it is cool on Thursday and rain falls in places.
